title: Beacon Ridge Residential Electricity Supply: Renewable Content Label
content:
Renewable content on Residential Electricity Supply plans is measured as the share of the customer's usage matched with renewable energy certificates beyond the state portfolio standard. The label below states that share for each plan, the kind of certificate retired for it, and whether the customer receives an annual statement of the certificates retired on their behalf.

| Plan | Renewable content beyond the state standard | Certificate retired | Annual retirement statement |
|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Monthly Variable | 0% | none | no |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 6 | 0% | none | no |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 12 | 0% | none | no |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 24 | 0% | none | no |
| Beacon Ridge Free Nights 12 | 0% | none | no |
| Beacon Ridge Clean Wind 12 | 100% | Green-e Energy certified national wind RECs | yes |
| Beacon Ridge Clean Wind 24 | 100% | Green-e Energy certified PJM wind RECs | yes |

"None" in the certificate column means the plan carries no voluntary renewable content.

**Reading the label.** The two Clean Wind plans match 100% of usage with wind certificates and are the only plans whose customers receive an annual statement of retired certificates. The two plans differ in the certificate retired: the 12-month plan retires national wind certificates, the 24-month plan retires PJM wind certificates. Every other plan carries 0% voluntary renewable content.
